```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```
We start with the table of 2,119 samples (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1etuHHVN-Qp1wSHYS4RmYNLXaALZQZabgQFIybjs5iHk/edit?gid=313754304#gid=313754304)
```{r}
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_based_on_raw_bamfiles_with_summary.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
```


```{r}
print(paste("number of samples before filtering:", length(unique(sampledata$unique_id))))
print(paste("number of accessions before filtering:", length(unique(sampledata$Accession))))
replicate_counts <- sampledata %>%
  filter(Accession != 6909, Genotype %in% c("F1_Col", "F1_ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(Accession, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_replicates = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_replicates >= 2)
print(paste("number of accessions with >=2 replicates before filtering:", length(unique(replicate_counts$Accession))))
```
# Miscrossed accessions filtering
The first thing we check if there are any mis-crossed accessions. For that we run ibdpaint and checked them visually.
Accessions which are detected to be selfed 6909 were re-assigned
```{r}
# Keep only ibdpaint confirmed samples
sampledata <- sampledata %>% filter(ibdpaint == "yes" | ibdpaint == "6909" )
print(paste("number of samples with ibdpaint:", length(unique(sampledata$Sample_id))))
print(paste("number of accessions with ibdpaint:", length(unique(sampledata$Accession))))

# Replicate count 
replicate_counts <- sampledata %>%
  filter(Accession != 6909, Genotype %in% c("F1_Col", "F1_ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(Accession, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_replicates = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_replicates >= 2)

print(paste("number of accessions with >=2 replicates:", length(unique(replicate_counts$Accession))))
```

# Filter Sanger not confirmed controls 
We checked our controls (ddm1 Col0) with Sanger sequencing to see that ddm1 mutation happened. Not confirmed samples are filtered out 
```{r}
sampledata <- sampledata %>% filter(is.na(Status_sanger) | Status_sanger != "FAIL")
print(paste("number of samples with failed sanger check:", length(unique(sampledata$Sample_id))))
print(paste("number of accessions with failed sanger check::", length(unique(sampledata$Accession))))
# Replicate count 
replicate_counts <- sampledata %>%
  filter(Accession != 6909, Genotype %in% c("F1_Col", "F1_ddm1")) %>%
  group_by(Accession, Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_replicates = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_replicates >= 2)

print(paste("number of accessions with >=2 replicates:", length(unique(replicate_counts$Accession))))
```

##############################
## Clustering of samples ##
##############################
The idea here is to use PCA data to filter out samples which does not fit 
```{r}
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_based_on_raw_bamfiles_with_summary.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
library(tximport)
# Base directory for RSEM outputs
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/quantification"
# Construct sample paths 
sample_paths <- file.path(rsem_base_dir)
# Collect gene results 
files <- file.path(sample_paths, paste0(sampledata$unique_id, ".genes.results"))
# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]
# Get the sample IDs from sampledata that correspond to existing files
file_indices <- which(file.exists(files))
fileSampleIDs <- sampledata$unique_id[file_indices]
# Create a named vector for tximport with proper sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs
# Verify the names are correct
head(names(existing_files))
# Perform tximport for RSEM quantification
txi.rsem <- tximport(existing_files,
                     type    = "rsem")

# Check column names now
head(colnames(txi.rsem$counts))
dim(txi.rsem$counts)

# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampledata[sampledata$unique_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$unique_id

# Subset txi.rsem
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.rsem object
txi.rsem$abundance <- txi.rsem$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$counts <- txi.rsem$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$length <- txi.rsem$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]

# Now extract counts
counts <- txi.rsem$counts
rownames(counts) <-rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
dim(counts)
```

```{r}
# Perform filtering 
library(edgeR)
colnames(counts) <- (paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id,filteredSampleData$unique_id, sep="_"))
# Define variant 
variant <- factor(filteredSampleData$Variant)
genotype <- factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)

# Drop samples with all 0 counts
lib <- colSums(counts)
print(lib[lib == 0])
# drop them from counts and metadata
ok <- lib > 0
counts <- counts[, ok]
filteredSampleData <- filteredSampleData[ok, ]
# rebuild
d0 <- DGEList(counts = counts)

## Filter based on the genotype and number of samples 
genotype <- factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)

d0 <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = genotype)

# Feature filter: expressed in any 3 samples
keep <- filterByExpr(
  d0,
  group = genotype,
  min.count = 10,        # CPM cutoff = 10 / median(lib.size) * 1e6
  min.total.count = 15,
  large.n = 3,           # required samples = 3 + (smallest group - 3) * min.prop
  min.prop = 0           # = 3 samples, whatever the group sizes
)
cat("Features retained:", sum(keep), "of", nrow(d0), "\n")

d0_filtered <- d0[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
d0_filtered <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered)
# Print summary
cat("Total genes before filtering:", nrow(d0), "\n")
cat("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(d0_filtered), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(nrow(d0_filtered)/nrow(d0)*100, 1), "%\n")

# Before filtering
log_cpm_before <- cpm(d0, log=TRUE)
log_cpm_after  <- cpm(d0_filtered, log = TRUE)   # uses normalization factors after calcNormFactors

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(density(log_cpm_before), main = "Before filtering", xlab = "log2 CPM")
plot(density(log_cpm_after),  main = "After filtering",  xlab = "log2 CPM")
```
## Construct PCA 
```{r}
# Transpose so samples are rows, features are columns
## Select genes and TEs
log_cpm_after_tes <- grepl("AT[1-5]TE", rownames(log_cpm_after))
log_cpm_after_tes <- log_cpm_after[log_cpm_after_tes, ]
log_cpm_after_genes <- !grepl("AT[1-5]TE", rownames(log_cpm_after))
log_cpm_after_genes <- log_cpm_after[log_cpm_after_genes, ]
pca_input <- t(log_cpm_after_tes)
# Run PCA (center and scale as needed)
pca_res <- prcomp(pca_input, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

# Build a data frame for plotting
library(data.table)
pca_df <- as.data.table(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
pca_df[, sample_id := rownames(pca_res$x)]
pca_df[, genotype := sub("^([^_]+_[^_]+).*", "\\1", sample_id)]
# Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample_id,color = genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    title = "PCA of log CPM expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
# Construct clustering (heatmap) per plate 
```{r}
library(pheatmap)

samples  <- colnames(log_cpm_after)
genotype <- sub("^(F1_ddm1|F1_Col|ddm1_ct|ct_col)_.*$", "\\1", samples)
rest <- sub("^(F1_ddm1|F1_Col|ddm1_ct|ct_col)_", "", samples)
run  <- setNames(
  vapply(strsplit(rest, "_", fixed = TRUE), `[`, character(1), 3L),
  samples
)
names(genotype) <- samples
names(run)      <- samples
# Filter only TEs
is_te   <- grepl("^AT[1-5]TE", rownames(log_cpm_after))
mat_tes <- as.matrix(log_cpm_after[is_te, ])
# Save output
outdir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/heatmaps_plates"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# Generate heatmaps 
geno_levels <- c("F1_Col", "F1_ddm1", "ddm1_ct", "ct_col")
all_results <- list()

for (r in unique(run)) {
  # Samples belonging to this run
  run_samples <- samples[run == r]
  if (length(run_samples) < 2) next
  # Subset TE matrix to this run
  mat <- mat_tes[, run_samples, drop = FALSE]
  # Keep the 500 most variable TEs
  te_var <- apply(mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  te_var <- te_var[is.finite(te_var) & te_var > 0]
  if (length(te_var) < 2) next
  top_tes <- names(sort(te_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(500, length(te_var)))]
  # Genotype colour bar on top of heatmap
  col_annotation <- data.frame(
    Genotype  = factor(genotype[run_samples], levels = geno_levels),
    row.names = run_samples
  )
  # Draw heatmap (silent = TRUE suppresses auto-plotting)
  ph <- pheatmap(
    mat[top_tes, ],
    scale                    = "row",
    clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
    clustering_method        = "complete",
    annotation_col           = col_annotation,
    show_rownames            = FALSE,
    fontsize_col             = 7,
    border_color             = NA,
    main                     = paste0("Run ", r, " (", length(run_samples), " samples)"),
    silent                   = TRUE
  )

  # Assign each sample to a dendrogram cluster
  n_clusters <- max(length(unique(genotype[run_samples])), 2)
  clusters   <- cutree(ph$tree_col, k = n_clusters)

  # Build result table for this run
  result <- data.frame(
    sample   = run_samples,
    run      = r,
    genotype = genotype[run_samples],
    cluster  = clusters[run_samples]
  )
  all_results[[r]] <- result

  # Save CSV and PDF
  write.csv(result,
    file      = file.path(outdir, paste0("run_", r, "_samples.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

  pdf(file.path(outdir, paste0("run_", r, "_heatmap.pdf")), width = 12, height = 9)
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  dev.off()
}

# Save combined across all runs 
all_samples <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
write.csv(all_samples,
  file      = file.path(outdir, "all_runs_samples.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
